evals.name: rename-home-services-app
evals.prompt: i'm building a home-services marketplace app in Pakistan (plumbers, electricians, AC repair, cleaners) — two apps, one for customers and one for providers. current working name is 'Ez Hand' but i think it's weak. help me find a better name. Pakistan first, then UAE and Saudi. should feel trustworthy but friendly, not corporate.
evals.expected_output: Brief/strategy first (onliness, associations, criteria), then a curated shortlist of 8-12 names in safe/bold pairs with stories, in-context store titles, linguistic flags for Urdu/Arabic, architecture advice for the two apps, and a costed validation checklist (IPO-Pakistan, Madrid, classes).
assertions: Lists clarifying brief questions before generating names
Writes a brief/strategy (onliness statement or core associations) before the name list
States evaluation criteria for choosing a name
Shortlist contains 8-12 curated names (not a dump of 30+)
Presents names as safe vs bold options/pairs
Shows names in context as an app-store title within 30 characters
Flags Urdu and Arabic meaning/pronunciation checks by native speakers
Addresses brand architecture for the customer and provider apps
Validation steps mention IPO-Pakistan and the Madrid Protocol
States that checks done are preliminary, not legal clearance
Stays in scope: no theme code/token files or identity routes; offers them as a next step
Any scorecard totals shown add up correctly from their per-criterion scores

evals.name: flutter-theme-from-brand
evals.prompt: Turn my ride-hailing brand into a Flutter theme. Brand colour is #FFC300 (taxi yellow), secondary is near-black #111111. Feel: bold, fast, reliable. I need light + dark ThemeData and design tokens I can reuse.
evals.expected_output: DTCG-format tokens JSON, Dart ColorScheme.fromSeed with a deliberate variant (fidelity/vibrant) plus light/dark/high-contrast, notes that yellow seed needs dark onPrimary, actual contrast numbers checked, icon guidance.
assertions: Produces a DTCG-format tokens file using $value and $type
Provides both light and dark ThemeData
Uses dark (not white) foreground on the yellow primary
Reports numeric WCAG contrast ratios for key colour pairs
Offers a high-contrast variant (contrastLevel or equivalent)
Keeps the exact brand hex separately from the generated seed scheme
Token colour values use the DTCG 2025.10 object form (colorSpace + components)
Verifies contrast on the generated scheme roles (not only the two brand hexes)
Light-mode surfaces are neutral (not seed-tinted cream) or the tint is explicitly justified

evals.name: rename-savings-app
evals.prompt: my app is called Time Vault — people lock money toward a goal (like a car or wedding) and can't withdraw until the date. users are in pakistan, payments via stripe, maybe raast later. i feel the name is generic. should i rename? want it to feel safe and trustworthy but also motivating, not like a boring bank.
evals.expected_output: Verdict on Time Vault for a fintech savings product (descriptive, crowded, existing TIME VAULT mark), brief with finance-specific associations, 8-12 names in safe/bold pairs with store titles, Urdu/Islamic-finance sensitivity flags (e.g. riba/interest connotations), class 36 added for financial services, SECP/SBP regulatory naming notes as a flag, no theme files.
assertions: Gives a clear keep/rename verdict with reasons
Writes a brief (associations / onliness) before suggesting names
Shortlist of 8-12 names presented as safe vs bold options
Each shortlisted name has a store title within 30 characters
Includes Nice class 36 (financial services) in addition to 9/42
Flags Urdu/Islamic-finance sensitivities (e.g. interest/riba connotations) or native-speaker checks
Labels conflict checks as preliminary, not legal clearance
Stays in scope: no theme code/token files; offers identity as a next step
